Skip to constructions

How to Construct High Barrycades

Certified constructions

Explore the brick arrangements. Barrycades have two ends; corrals close into a loop. In a breakfree construction, no two rows have a joint in the same position. A balanced construction puts exactly one joint from each row in every block of h consecutive positions, where h is its height.

Each cell counts joints in one row and one block of 2 consecutive positions. Balanced means every cell is 1. Rows run down; blocks run across. Green: 1 joint. Orange: 0 or multiple joints. The two ends are excluded.
